title: Llama reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Llama neck -->
  <rect x='40' y='32' width='12' height='36' rx='6' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Neck highlight -->
  <rect x='42' y='34' width='4' height='30' rx='2' fill='#fff3dd'/>
  <!-- Llama head -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='30' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='18' rx='3.5' ry='8' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='18' rx='3.5' ry='8' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='19' rx='2' ry='5.5' fill='#e8b4b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='19' rx='2' ry='5.5' fill='#e8b4b8'/>
  <!-- Llama face/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='35' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ffe8cc'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='2.2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='28' r='2.2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='42.7' cy='27.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='51.7' cy='27.3' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='34' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#c9887a'/>
  <path d='M45 37 Q47 38.5 49 37' stroke='#b07060' stroke-width='0.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <rect x='42' y='77' width='5' height='13' rx='2.5' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <rect x='54' y='77' width='5' height='13' rx='2.5' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <rect x='62' y='76' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='33' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a97a'/>
  <rect x='41' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a97a'/>
  <rect x='53' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a97a'/>
  <rect x='61' y='87' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a97a'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 65 60)'>
    <rect x='55' y='50' width='22' height='16' rx='2' fill='#4a90d9'/>
    <!-- Book pages -->
    <rect x='57' y='52' width='18' height='12' rx='1' fill='#fff8ee'/>
    <line x1='66' y1='52' x2='66' y2='64' stroke='#d0c0a0' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- Book text lines -->
    <line x1='58' y1='55' x2='64' y2='55' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='58' x2='63' y2='58' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='58' y1='61' x2='64' y2='61' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='55' x2='74' y2='55' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='58' x2='73' y2='58' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='61' x2='74' y2='61' stroke='#a0b8d0' stroke-width='0.8'/>
    <!-- Book spine -->
    <rect x='55' y='50' width='2' height='16' rx='1' fill='#3a70b0'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Llama arm holding book -->
  <path d='M56 56 Q62 52 58 49' stroke='#f0d9b5' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='66' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#f0d9b5'/>
</svg>
